$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$toolRoot='C:\Users\gb\.codex\tmp\pvground_selected_mask_training_20261009\postrun_tools'
$reviewRoot=Join-Path $toolRoot 'source_review'
$priorRoot=Split-Path -Parent $toolRoot
$spanRunner='C:\Users\gb\.codex\tmp\pvground_extremal_span_evidence_20261009\runner_v1'
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $reviewRoot) { throw 'Retention review directory already exists; refuse overwrite' }
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path (Join-Path $reviewRoot 'snapshots') | Out-Null
$priorReviewPaths=@((Join-Path $spanRunner 'source_review'),(Join-Path $priorRoot 'postrun_source_review_20261009'))
$baseline=@($priorReviewPaths | ForEach-Object { Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $_ -File -Recurse } | Sort-Object FullName | ForEach-Object { [ordered]@{path=$_.FullName;bytes=$_.Length;sha256=(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $_.FullName -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()} })
$baseline | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $reviewRoot 'PRIOR_AUDIT_PRESERVATION_BASELINE.json') -Encoding UTF8
$inputs=@('prepare_retention_plan.py','retire_closed_pair_authorized.py','TOOL_PREPARATION.json','SOURCE_AUDIT_REQUEST.txt') | ForEach-Object { Join-Path $toolRoot $_ }
$inputs += @('pair_spec.json','postrun_source\analyze_selected_pair.py','postrun_source\inspect_closed_terminals_authorized.py','postrun_source\collect_closed_pair_authorized.py','postrun_source_review_20261009\SOURCE_REVIEW_R3.md','postrun_source_review_20261009\SOURCE_REVIEW_R3.json','controller.py') | ForEach-Object { Join-Path $priorRoot $_ }
$inputs += @('finalize_parent.py','pair_spec_template.json','source_review\LAUNCH_SOURCE_REVIEW_R5.md','source_review\LAUNCH_SOURCE_REVIEW_R5.json') | ForEach-Object { Join-Path $spanRunner $_ }
$index=0
$manifest=@($inputs | ForEach-Object { $index+=1; $item=Get-Item -LiteralPath $_; $snap='snapshots\{0:D3}_{1}' -f $index,$item.Name; Copy-Item -LiteralPath $item.FullName -Destination (Join-Path $reviewRoot $snap); [ordered]@{path=$item.FullName;snapshot=$snap;bytes=$item.Length;sha256=(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $item.FullName -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()} })
$manifest | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $reviewRoot 'INPUT_MANIFEST.json') -Encoding UTF8
Copy-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $toolRoot 'SOURCE_AUDIT_REQUEST.txt') -Destination (Join-Path $reviewRoot 'EXACT_REQUEST.txt')
[ordered]@{prior_audit_artifacts=$baseline.Count;inputs=$manifest.Count;tool_hashes=@($manifest|Select-Object -First 2)} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10
